publicExposureRules: Never expose internal manifest state names, raw provider errors, API credentials, reviewer identity, or policy decision IDs.
COVERED_AS_OF describes only the declared source/query/window/subject scope and as-of; it is not market-wide completeness.
PARTIAL may be returned only when the covered/missing scope and any displayed counts are approved for the exact public action; otherwise return UNVERIFIABLE or SUPPRESSED_RIGHTS.
NOT_FOUND_IN_SCOPE and NOT_REPORTED are result meanings, not coverage completeness states.
validEmptyRequirements: exact provider/product/endpoint and query filters recorded
issuer/instrument applicability and temporal scope resolved for the requested subject
all required pages enumerated with terminal page and response status verified
page metadata and observed response counts reconcile under an approved policy
no transport/API/parse/quota/auth errors or omitted page
required correction/withdrawal reconciliation watermark is current and complete
rights decision permits recording and exposing this result and its counts
negativeEvidenceContract.validEmptyMeaning: NOT_FOUND_IN_SCOPE_ONLY; no matching row was returned in this exact completed provider query scope and snapshot.
negativeEvidenceContract.notReportedMeaning: The retrieved, identified source document was examined and the specific expected assertion was not stated in that document; this is not a market-wide no-event conclusion.
unverifiableConditions: provider error, quota/rate limit, timeout, HTTP failure or malformed response
ambiguous issuer/instrument mapping or incomplete declared source universe
rights prevent required search, retention, or publication
source pagination may have shifted during the scan and no approved stable snapshot/reconciliation closes the gap
forbiddenInference: empty list/013 does not mean no filing exists outside the exact query window or source
no matching filing does not mean the event did not occur
missing field in one structured API response does not mean the filing omitted the fact
NOT_REPORTED in a read document does not mean the subject has no related event
suppressed or rights-blocked search must not be exposed as zero results
negativeEvidenceContract.dossierHeadlineRule: No negative/no-event/no-risk headline from absence alone. Show scope-limited availability and coverage state; outcome remains UNVERIFIED unless a separate reviewed evidence relation establishes it.
negativeEvidenceContract.partialResultRule: Do not call an incomplete scan empty. Return UNVERIFIABLE or a policy-approved PARTIAL status with explicit requested/covered window and withheld denominator; if count disclosure itself lacks rights, omit counts and suppress the result.

currentRepositoryCollectorObservation.queryScope: single KST receipt date, list.json, page_count=100

scopeSemantics.directInstrumentFacts: Include only when exact affected instrument applicability is verified for this snapshot.
scopeSemantics.issuerFacts: Exclude by default from instrument query; include only with includeIssuerContext=true and label CONTEXT_ONLY.
scopeSemantics.issuerContextCounts: Separate directItemCount, issuerContextItemCount and withheldOrUnresolvedCount; never mix counts.
scopeSemantics.partialSubject: Return only independently eligible subjects when the declared response contract permits partial results, with responseStatus=PARTIAL and per-subject reason; otherwise suppress complete response. Policy remains owner decision.
scopeSemantics.unresolvedApplicability: Do not attribute as instrument fact; preserve issuer-scoped observation where independently publishable.
scopeSemantics.multiInstrumentRequest: Each subject has independent eligibility/applicability/coverage disposition; shared issuer context never counts as instrument-specific event.

snapshotContract.pages: Cursor binds immutable materialized snapshot and canonical query scope; no transaction remains open between requests.
snapshotContract.revocation: A request seeing stale rights/publication epoch is suppressed. Cached rows are never reused as current; no 304 for changed or revoked snapshot.
snapshotContract.asOfSemantics: Distinguish snapshot capture time, source last reconciled time, document fetched time, projection commit time and response generated time.

pagination.stableSort: approved deterministic tuple with unique terminal key
pagination.pageBoundary: No duplicate or skipped item within immutable snapshot acceptance fixture

errorContract.safeBody: stable code only; no SQL, credentials, source body, private diagnostics or owner identity

knownLimitations: This proposal does not establish DART/KIND product or field rights.
Repository route/OpenAPI inventory does not enumerate deployed external consumers.
Static vectors do not prove runtime query isolation, cursor cryptography, pagination parity, UI rendering, or revocation propagation.
Do not deploy this proposal by changing the existing mixed-market v1 route.
